text:
Anna Support: hitting a production spike where retries are exploding CPU on our dedicated nodes. customers seeing 429 then rapid retries that pile up. raising to eng - any ideas?

Mike Eng: can you paste logs? which SDK version? are these from hosted or dedicated?

Anna Support: hosted for customer A, but repros on dedicated staging. python sdk v1.3.2. logs show backoff coordinator rejecting jitter seeds and then immediate retry loop. sample log: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z ERROR retry-coordinator: jitter-seed-mismatch for request id=abcd1234
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z WARN retry: backoff 0s -> scheduled retry
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z INFO request: id=abcd1234 status=429
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z ERROR retry: idempotency-key not attached on followup
```

Ben Infra: interesting, v1.3.2 changed coordinator protocol to include a seed handshake. older runtime expects numeric seed in header `X-Backoff-Seed`. If header missing, runtime falls back to 0 and triggers tight loop.

Julia Dev: that could explain a lot. customer reported a sudden jump in retries after we rolled a runtime patch a week ago. did the SDK change header name?

Anna Support: quick repro attached. minimal python snippet: 
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="sk-...")
resp = c.generate("repeat test", max_tokens=10)
```
Run this with concurrent threads (20x) and you'll see the retry flood when using connection pooling.

Mike Eng: @Ben Infra do we have mismatch mapping between client/sdk header names and runtime? Also which commit in sdk v1.3.2 introduced handshake?

Ben Infra: sdk v1.3.2 introduced `X-RW-Backoff-Seed` while runtime patch expects `X-Backoff-Seed`. We pushed runtime change to normalize but there was a typo in the normalization table. runtime dropped header, so coordinator seeded 0 -> deterministic zero-jitter retries.

SRE Bot: Incident opened #INC-2026-314: high-retry-loop-dedicated-nodes. Severity: P2.

Mike Eng: ok plan: 1) short-term mitigation — force client to emit the compatibility header key and include a random seed in header. 2) runtime patch to accept both header names. 3) add e2e test to detect header mismatches.

Anna Support: how do I force client header? can we patch customer locally?

Julia Dev: quick workaround: set env var `RW_BACKOFF_SEED=auto` for now; SDK reads that and will include `X-Backoff-Seed` specifically. I'll ship a 1.3.3 hotfix with both headers.

Lisa Product: hold on billing/SLAs — this caused extra tokens through retries and some timeouts. Need a note to CS and a mitigation credit for affected customers.

Mike Eng: agreed. Anna, collect affected org ids and percent retry increase. I'll prioritize runtime fix.

Anna Support: sending list now. also noticed idempotency header sometimes missing on retries (see log). could be another bug in connection reuse.

Ben Infra: that might be a second repro path: if retry loop is tight, idempotency header generation gets raced with connection reuse and header gets dropped. We'll instrument header attach path.

Julia Dev: repro steps I used locally: 
1) run a small flask app that makes 50 concurrent requests through requests.Session pool size=25
2) use python sdk v1.3.2
3) throttle server to return 429 for 1 in 3 requests
4) observe repeated immediate retries, and check request headers with tcpdump or proxy

Example tcpdump snippet showing header missing: 
```
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-...
Content-Type: application/json
X-RW-Backoff-Seed: 12345

# next retry on same connection:
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-...
Content-Type: application/json
# X-Backoff-Seed missing
```

Mike Eng: marking as two linked problems: header key mismatch (1.3.2 vs runtime) and header loss under connection reuse -> concurrency race. I'll open two PRs.

SRE Bot: Deploy Bot queued patch: runtime/patch/normalize-backoff-headers -> canary in us-west-2 tonight.

Deploy Bot: deployment started for runtime/patch/normalize-backoff-headers (canary us-west-2)

Anna Support: thanks all. I'll notify affected customers and add a short postmortem to the ticket. :thumbsup:

Ben Infra: followups: add e2e that simulates header key variants; add unit test for idempotency header attachment during pooled-connection retries.

Julia Dev: I'll draft SDK hotfix 1.3.3 that emits both `X-Backoff-Seed` and `X-RW-Backoff-Seed` and ensures idempotency header is attached even after retry header regeneration.

Mike Eng: ETA on hotfix?

Julia Dev: aiming for 24h for release candidate, 48h for rollout.

Anna Support: noted, passing to CS. closing this thread once runtime canary is green.

Lisa Product: please cc me on customer communication, we'll prepare credits and an FAQ blurb.
